title: A Regularized Auxiliary Variable (RAV) Approach for Gradient Flows
summary: In this paper, we propose a regularized auxiliary variable (RAV) approach and construct accurate and robust time-discrete schemes for a large class of gradient flows. By introducing an auxiliary variable $r=0$ and constructing an auxiliary equation that naturally fits into the energy relation, the numerical solution $r^{n+1}$ of the auxiliary variable is corrected at each time step to preserve consistency with the original system.
